Hi team —

We have two upcoming renewals that overlap in Q1: the corporate mobile/data plan (currently billed monthly across multiple BroadLink accounts) and our hotdesk allotment at the Market St SpaceHub location (renewal due mid-Jan). Finance asked whether we can simplify vendor flows by consolidating telecom billing under a single BroadLink master bill and sign a one-off quarterly addendum with SpaceHub for the additional 24 desks we plan to onboard.

Key asks:
- Marcus: can you confirm whether we can accept a single consolidated invoice from BroadLink tied to our AP/PO structure (POs are usually per vendor per quarter).
- Evelyn: can you confirm headcount & seat mapping for Market St — I think 24 seats for Sales/CS + on-call engineers.
- Arun / Courtney: can you provide an estimated combined cadence and any discounts for consolidated billing / seat-block renewals?

If BroadLink can give a single invoice and SpaceHub will accept a Q1 addendum (no longer than 90 days), we could reduce AP overhead and simplify chargebacks. Marcus/Evelyn — can you please respond by EOD Tuesday 12/1? Arun/Courtney — any doc/attachment you want to share is fine.

Thanks —
Lauren

Thanks Lauren. Short answers and next steps from Finance: 

- We can accept a single consolidated monthly invoice from BroadLink if it references a single PO number and includes a clear line-item breakdown by cost center. Our AP system requires invoice -> PO matching.
- If BroadLink wants to bill per site but send an aggregated invoice, we need an attachment with the mapping CSV (site_id, cost_center, employee_count, monthly_charge). If BroadLink can provide that mapping automatically each month, we can auto-match in our ERP.
- For SpaceHub: we prefer a quarterly invoice with a statement of seats and prorated charges. If they need monthly, we can accept it but would like a single quarterly statement for internal chargebacks.

Evelyn — can you confirm seat list (name + cost center) by EOD Monday? I can then create PO RED-2026-78 and share a PO template.

Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
